A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the presented empirical model is a good candidate for future 3GPP indoor channel models, as well as a reference for other standard bodies, and it can be used to complement the current 3GPP outdoor-to-indoor channel model.
the model is able to accurately describe the path loss behavior of the scenarios, with a median error of 0.7 dB and 90th percentile error of 3.2 dB, for a total of 13 000 samples.
the model is applicable to any frequency band from below 1 GHz up to cm-wave frequency bands, with an accuracy of about 3 dB, which is comparable to the accuracy of the 3G-PP and ITU models.

the model is able to predict the path loss for all the measured frequency bands with an accuracy of 2–3 dB for the majority of the scenarios, which can help in the design of future wireless communication systems.
